### Props

| Name            | Type            | Required | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------- | --------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `dataSource`    | `object`        |          | `null`      | Manifest dataSource block. See `useDataSource`. Exactly one of `dataSource` / `entries` must be provided — a stats-block widget without any source has no count to render (flagged with a console error at mount).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `entries`       | `Array<object>` |          | `[]`        | Multi-entry declarative sources (ADR-049). Each entry renders one KPI within this widget's card and self-fetches its own count over the REST /value aggregation: `{ title, register, schema, metric, field, filter, route, variant, countLabel, hideWhenZero }`. Filter values use the shared @-token grammar (`@today`, `@me`, `@workspace.*`, `?`-optional clauses). An entry with `hideWhenZero` is omitted when its resolved count is 0. Mutually exclusive with `dataSource`; defaults to empty (single-source mode).                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `title`         | `string`        |          | `''`        | Block title (manifest `widgetDef.title`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `countLabel`    | `string`        |          | `''`        | Label displayed next to the count.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `variant`       | `string`        |          | `'default'` | Color variant: default \| primary \| success \| warning \| error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `showZeroCount` | `boolean`       |          | `true`      | Whether to show 0 as a real count instead of the empty label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `horizontal`    | `boolean`       |          | `false`     | Lay the icon left of the content. The canonical KPI card already does this, so the prop is redundant and kept only for existing callers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `vertical`      | `boolean`       |          | `false`     | Stack the icon above a centred number instead of beside it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `filled`        | `boolean`       |          | `false`     | Draw each tile's own grey box. Off by default — the widget is rendered inside a CnWidgetWrapper that already draws a card.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `route`         | `union`         |          | `null`      | Vue-router location to navigate to on click. When set, the inner CnStatsBlock renders as a `&lt;router-link&gt;`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `iconClass`     | `string`        |          | `''`        | Optional CSS class applied to the widget's outermost wrapping `&lt;div&gt;`. Designed for Nextcloud core icon classes (`icon-link`, `icon-mail`, `icon-history`, …) that ship with NC and render a 16×16 glyph via background-image. When empty (the default), the wrapper carries only the base `cn-stats-block-widget` class and is visually invisible. The wrapping element is a `&lt;div&gt;` with no layout styles of its own, so the rendered KPI tile keeps the same dimensions and spacing it had before this prop was added. MDI icon names (e.g. `'Database'`) are NOT supported here — that would require an async dynamic-import. Use `CnStatsBlock` directly when you need an MDI Vue component icon. |
